== Text == Legion
Legendary
Warrior/Sorcerer
Legion is a monster of tremendous force and gigantic size. It has the magical power to absorb the shells of the Titans fought in various battles taking possession of their powers to then use against enemies! Attack:6
Defense:4
Special Abilities:Titan Absorption
